title: Use the binomial series
text: The binomial series is $$\left(1+u\right)^r=1+r u+\frac{r \left(r-1\right)}{2} u^2$$ and so on. Use $$r=\frac{-1}{3}$$ and $$u=x^2$$.

title: Compute the coefficients
text: The coefficients are $$1$$, $$\frac{-1}{3}$$ and $$\frac{\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right) \left(-\frac{4}{3}\right)}{2}=\frac{2}{9}$$. With $$u=x^2$$ this gives $$1-\frac{x^2}{3}+\frac{2x^4}{9}$$.
